user.title: Set up BACnet Hub
user.description: Please enter instance number, local address, object name and description.

error.invalid_address: Invalid address. Allowed format: IP[/prefix][:port], for example 192.168.31.36/24:47808.

data_description.write_priority: Priority used for writes to commandable points of all client devices. 8 = Manual Operator (overrides the controller's own program until the slot is released), 16 = lowest priority.

labels.title: Labels import
labels.description: Select one or more labels. Matching entities are mapped automatically on registry/label/area updates.

error.invalid_label_selection: Please select at least one valid label.
error.invalid_write_priority: Please choose a write priority between 8 and 16.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads a BACnet Hub config entry.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional. If omitted and only one BACnet Hub entry exists, that entry is reloaded.

release.name: Release manual override
release.description: Releases the selected priority slot of a commandable BACnet point (writes Null to the priority array).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: BACnet priority (1-16) whose slot is released. Defaults to 8 (Manual Operator).

set_out_of_service.name: Set out of service
set_out_of_service.description: Sets the outOfService property of one or more BACnet points. While out of service the present value is decoupled from the physical input/output and can be written directly.

out_of_service.name: Out of service
out_of_service.description: true takes the point out of service, false returns it to normal operation.
